title: Davey O'Brien semifinalists: all 13 on the board
parts:
🏆 DEVYDOSE DAILY BUZZ | Davey O'Brien semifinalists

All 13 QBs named semifinalists for the Davey O'Brien Award are on the Alpha Draft Signal board, and two are sophomores (via Davey O'Brien Foundation) 🧵👇

📈 The board's top 5 of the 13:

• C.J. Carr | Notre Dame | JR | #2 QB
• Drew Mestemaker | Oklahoma State | JR | #4 QB
• Conner Weigman | Houston | SR | #5 QB
• Darian Mensah | Miami | JR | #7 QB
• Keelon Russell | Alabama | SO, 5⭐ | #8 QB

🌱 The two sophomores:
• Keelon Russell (Alabama): #8 QB, up from #18 preseason
• Bear Bachmeier (BYU): #48 QB

🚀 Biggest climbers since preseason:
• Gio Lopez (Wake Forest): #155 → #31
• Marcus Stokes (Memphis): #597 → #54

The rest: Gunner Stockton (Georgia) #10 · Devon Dampier (Utah) #23 · LaNorris Sellers (South Carolina) #30 · Trinidad Chambliss (Ole Miss) #43 · Noah Fifita (Arizona) #46

Dampier was also National QB of the Week on Nov 17.

Finalists come Nov 24. Your pick? 👇
